newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy BTP spread over 10-yr bund at new record.
newsitem.headline: Italy BTP spread over 10-yr bund at new record.

text.p: The spread between the benchmark Italian BTP bond and the 10-year German bund fell to a record low of 83 basis points in early trading, dealers said.

AT 0740 GMT, the benchmark Feb 2007 BTP bond was up 60 basis points at 103.72, with the market boosted by Federal Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan's comments late Tuesday which helped allay fears of rising U.S. inflation.
